g.title: A
g.text: ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md · ADR 0002–0013 · status as of stage 2

g.title: users
g.text: Brand manager · Service engineer · Warehouse keeper

g.title: web
g.text: Blazor WebAssembly + MudBlazor, runs in the browser

g.title: host
g.text: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs · OpenAPI · ProblemDetails

g.title: bff
g.text: claims-based policies · serves the WASM client

g.title: pipe
g.text: own ICommandHandler / IQueryHandler instead of MediatR
decorators: logging → validation → transaction (unit of work)

g.title: bus
g.text: dispatcher with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, idempotent inbox

g.title: mods
g.text: Domain/ aggregates and Features/ use cases come with the module's stage (ADR 0013)

g.title: jobs
g.text: reservation expiry · mart refresh · audit purge

g.title: db
g.text: ref · util · audit (Platform) │ iam │ catalog · inventory · raw · staging │ fleet │ procurement │ forecast │ mart
no FKs, JOINs or transactions across modules · outbox / inbox and __ef_migrations_history per module
triggers · functions · views · materialised views · roles and grants (SQL parts in db/sql/<module>)

g.title: t_db
g.text: PostgreSQL 17 — one database, schemas owned by modules (ADR 0011)
locally Aspire / docker compose, in CI Testcontainers · Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server (stage 9)

g.title: ci
g.text: SQL suite on the EF-built database

g.title: runner
g.text: bootstrap + EF migrations in ModuleCatalog order
check-model · used by Aspire and CI

g.title: deploy
g.text: OIDC sign-in · EF migration bundle per context
→ PostgreSQL as smartspare_migrator, then the container
